subject.title: Stale client registration replayed to DCR forever; only --reset recovers

question: Which observed DCR response or provider condition is sufficient to invalidate a cached client registration and retry once without treating transient registration failures as permanent?
rationale: The current source confirms the missing recovery branch, but the safety of deleting persisted client state depends on distinguishing an invalid client registration from a temporary provider failure.

options.title: Validate a durable DCR signal first
options.body: Reproduce the Supabase GoTrue project-ref change and define the specific response/context that permits one invalidation-and-retry path.

options.title: Retry generic DCR failures
options.body: Invalidate and retry after any DCR error, accepting the risk of unnecessary client churn during transient provider failures.

recommendation.title: Validate a durable DCR signal first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the Supabase GoTrue project-ref change and define the specific response/context that permits one invalidation-and-retry path.
